datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Yemen to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) for near-term projections across 2019, capturing the spatial distribution and severity of food insecurity impacts.
